title: "Dimension Tables"

# Dimension Table Architecture

The BMF pipeline creates **dimension tables** for fields that contain multiple values per organization. This follows the **SCD Type 2** (Slowly Changing Dimension) pattern from data warehousing.

## Why Dimension Tables?

Some BMF fields pack multiple codes into a single column:

- **ACTIVITY**: 9 characters = 3 activity codes (3 chars each)
- **CLASSIFICATION**: Up to 4 classification codes (1 char each)
- **NTEE_CD**: Single NTEE code that maps to multiple attributes

Dimension tables **unpivot** these into normalized structures, enabling:
- Analysis by individual code values
- Joining with lookup tables for descriptions
- Aggregation across organizations by activity/classification

## Entity Relationship Diagram

```{mermaid}
erDiagram
    BMF_FACT ||--o{ DIM_ACTIVITY : "ein"
    BMF_FACT ||--o{ DIM_CLASSIFICATION : "ein"
    BMF_FACT ||--o| DIM_NTEE : "ein"

    BMF_FACT {
        string ein PK "XX-XXXXXXX"
        string org_name_display
        string subsection_code
        string exempt_organization_type
        date ruling_date
        numeric asset_amount
        numeric income_amount
        string activity_code_definitions "aggregated"
        string all_classifications_string "aggregated"
    }

    DIM_ACTIVITY {
        int rowID PK
        string ein FK
        string activity_code "3-char code"
        string activity_code_definition
        string activity_code_category
        string effective_year
    }

    DIM_CLASSIFICATION {
        int rowID PK
        string ein FK
        string subsection_code
        string cl_code "1-char code"
        string classification_description
        string effective_year
    }

    DIM_NTEE {
        int rowID PK
        string ein FK
        string ntee_code_raw
        string ntee_code_clean
        string ntee_code_definition
        string ntee_code_major_group
        string naics_code
        string nteev2_code
        string effective_year
    }
```

# dim_activity

**File:** `data/processed/dim_activity_2025.parquet`

**Created by:** `create_activity_code_dim_table()` in `R/activity_code.R`

## Schema

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `ein` | character | Employer Identification Number (FK to fact table) |
| `activity_code` | character | 3-character IRS activity code |
| `activity_code_definition` | character | Human-readable activity description |
| `activity_code_category` | character | Activity category grouping |

## Row Count

Each organization can have up to 3 activity codes, so:
- Fact table: ~1.9M rows
- dim_activity: ~3-5M rows (after filtering undefined codes)

## Creation Process

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    subgraph Input
        RAW["ACTIVITY column<br/>9 characters per org"]
    end

    subgraph Split["1. Extract Codes"]
        S1["Chars 1-3: Code 1"]
        S2["Chars 4-6: Code 2"]
        S3["Chars 7-9: Code 3"]
    end

    subgraph Melt["2. Melt to Long"]
        M["One row per code"]
    end

    subgraph Filter["3. Filter"]
        F["Remove '000' codes"]
    end

    subgraph Join["4. Join Lookup"]
        J["Add definitions"]
    end

    subgraph Output
        OUT[("dim_activity")]
    end

    RAW --> S1 & S2 & S3
    S1 & S2 & S3 --> M
    M --> F
    F --> J
    J --> OUT
```

## Example Data

| ein | activity_code | activity_code_definition | activity_code_category |
|-----|---------------|--------------------------|------------------------|
| 12-3456789 | 001 | Religious Activities | Religious |
| 12-3456789 | 029 | Scholarships | Educational |
| 12-3456789 | 060 | Low Income Housing | Housing |
| 98-7654321 | 001 | Religious Activities | Religious |

## Usage Examples

### Count organizations by activity

```r
# Load dimension table
dim_activity <- arrow::read_parquet("data/processed/dim_activity_2025.parquet")

# Count unique orgs per activity
dim_activity[, .(n_orgs = uniqueN(ein)), by = activity_code][order(-n_orgs)]
```

### Find orgs with specific activity

```r
# Organizations with educational activities
educational_orgs <- dim_activity[grepl("Educational", activity_code_category), unique(ein)]
```

### Join back to fact table

```r
# Get all activity codes for a specific org
dim_activity[ein == "12-3456789"]
```

# dim_classification

**File:** `data/processed/dim_classification_2025.parquet`

**Created by:** `create_cl_code_dim_table()` in `R/subsection_classification_codes.R`

## Schema

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `ein` | character | Employer Identification Number (FK) |
| `subsection_code` | character | IRC subsection (e.g., "03" for 501c3) |
| `cl_code` | character | Single classification code character |
| `classification_description` | character | Classification description |
| `effective_year` | character | Year of the BMF extract |
| `rowID` | integer | Unique row identifier |

## Creation Process

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    subgraph Input
        CLASS["CLASSIFICATION column<br/>up to 4 chars"]
        SUB["SUBSECTION column"]
    end

    subgraph Extract["1. Extract Chars"]
        C1["Char 1"]
        C2["Char 2"]
        C3["Char 3"]
        C4["Char 4"]
    end

    subgraph Melt["2. Melt to Long"]
        M["One row per char"]
    end

    subgraph Filter["3. Filter"]
        F["Remove '0' and empty"]
    end

    subgraph Join["4. Join Lookup"]
        J["Key: subsection + cl_code"]
    end

    subgraph Output
        OUT[("dim_classification")]
    end

    CLASS --> C1 & C2 & C3 & C4
    SUB --> Join
    C1 & C2 & C3 & C4 --> M
    M --> F
    F --> J
    J --> OUT
```

## Subsection-Specific Codes

Classification codes are **not universal** - they have different meanings based on the subsection. For example:

**501(c)(3) - subsection_code = "03":**
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 1 | Church |
| 2 | School |
| 3 | Hospital |
| 4 | Medical research |
| ... | ... |

**501(c)(4) - subsection_code = "04":**
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 1 | Civic league |
| 2 | Local association of employees |
| ... | ... |

## Example Data

| ein | subsection_code | cl_code | classification_description |
|-----|-----------------|---------|----------------------------|
| 12-3456789 | 03 | 1 | Church |
| 12-3456789 | 03 | 7 | Organization receiving substantial support from general public |
| 98-7654321 | 04 | 1 | Civic league |

# Aggregated Columns in Fact Table

The main fact table includes **aggregated** versions of dimension table data:

| Fact Column | Source | Aggregation |
|-------------|--------|-------------|
| `activity_code_definitions` | dim_activity | Semicolon-separated definitions |
| `activity_code_categories` | dim_activity | Semicolon-separated categories |
| `all_classifications_string` | dim_classification | Semicolon-separated descriptions |

## Example

For EIN 12-3456789 with 3 activity codes:

**dim_activity rows:**
```
activity_code_definition
------------------------
Religious Activities
Scholarships
Low Income Housing
```

**Fact table column:**
```
activity_code_definitions = "Religious Activities; Scholarships; Low Income Housing"
```

# Working with Dimension Tables

## Loading Dimension Tables

```r
library(data.table)
library(arrow)

# Load all tables
bmf <- arrow::read_parquet("data/processed/bmf_2025_processed.parquet")
dim_activity <- arrow::read_parquet("data/processed/dim_activity_2025.parquet")
dim_classification <- arrow::read_parquet("data/processed/dim_classification_2025.parquet")

# Convert to data.table for fast operations
setDT(bmf)
setDT(dim_activity)
setDT(dim_classification)
```

## Common Queries

### Organizations by activity category

```r
# Count orgs per activity category
activity_counts <- dim_activity[,
  .(n_orgs = uniqueN(ein)),
  by = activity_code_category
][order(-n_orgs)]

head(activity_counts)
#    activity_code_category n_orgs
# 1:               Religious 234567
# 2:             Educational 123456
# 3:              Charitable  98765
```

### Cross-tabulation: Subsection by Classification

```r
# Classification distribution within 501(c)(3)
c3_classifications <- dim_classification[
  subsection_code == "03",
  .(n_orgs = uniqueN(ein)),
  by = classification_description
][order(-n_orgs)]
```

### Join dimension data to fact table

```r
# Get full activity details for subset of orgs
large_orgs <- bmf[asset_amount > 1000000, .(ein, org_name_display, asset_amount)]

large_org_activities <- dim_activity[large_orgs, on = "ein", nomatch = NULL]
```

### Find organizations with multiple classifications

```r
# Orgs with more than 2 classification codes
multi_class <- dim_classification[,
  .(n_codes = .N),
  by = ein
][n_codes > 2]
```

# SCD Type 2 Pattern

The dimension tables are designed for **Slowly Changing Dimension Type 2** tracking:

## What is SCD Type 2?

When a dimension value changes (e.g., an org's activity codes change between years), SCD Type 2:

1. Keeps the old record with an end date
2. Creates a new record with a start date
3. Preserves full history

## Current Implementation

The current pipeline creates dimension tables **per year** with an `effective_year` column:

```
dim_activity_2024.parquet  # 2024 snapshot
dim_activity_2025.parquet  # 2025 snapshot
```

## Future Enhancement

For full SCD Type 2 support, add:

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `effective_start_date` | Date | When this record became active |
| `effective_end_date` | Date | When this record was superseded (NULL if current) |
| `is_current` | logical | TRUE if this is the current record |

This enables queries like:
- What were the activity codes for org X in 2020?
- When did org Y change its classification?
- How many orgs changed activities between 2024 and 2025?
